submission.reasoning: On workstation5, cmd.exe wrote C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\art.bat at 02:46:45.192Z, then launched elevated reg.exe as WORKSTATION5\wardog at 02:47:08.745Z. reg.exe successfully set HKCU\Environment\UserInitMprLogonScript to that batch file, establishing user-logon persistence. The staged temporary-directory script and confirmed autostart registry write support malicious persistence rather than an ordinary environment-variable update; no authorized administration or testing context was observed. Remove the persistence value and staged script, isolate the workstation, and rotate the account credentials. The evidence establishes persistence installation, not subsequent script execution or its contents.
